text:
Maya (Growth): quick sync on SummitBridge marketplace + joint webinar + co-auth blog. main ask: lock inbound lead routing so Sales gets demo-ready leads w/ company_size & primary_use_case. who owns what?
Jon (PMM): Ill own the webinar narrative and the benchmark callout. thinking a short bench showing cost-per-1M-embedding-ops on dedicated vs shared. propose webinar week of 2026-06-08. UTM naming: summitbridge_webinar_jun8? thoughts. :bar_chart:
Pri (PartnerOps): Ill own marketplace asset handoff. SummitBridge needs logo (SVG + PNG), two screenshots, 3 bullets (<=140 chars), and a 75-word partner blurb. partner can deliver assets if we send a checklist by Apr 27.
Rina (Content): need assets by May 4 to draft the co-auth blog and landing. will request a 300-450 word guest section from their PM. also will add GDPR consent copy for EU regs.
Omar (Sales Ops): routing plan: webhook -> SFDC lead create with partner_tag=summitbridge and lead_source=partner_marketplace. need immediate Slack alert to #inbound-sales for hot leads. webhook skeleton below — validate field names vs landing form.
Omar (Sales Ops): ```json
{
  "webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-ingest",
  "payload": {
    "email": "{{email}}",
    "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
    "last_name": "{{last_name}}",
    "company": "{{company}}",
    "job_title": "{{job_title}}",
    "company_size": "{{company_size}}",
    "primary_use_case": "{{primary_use_case}}",
    "utm_source": "summitbridge",
    "utm_campaign": "summitbridge_webinar_jun8",
    "partner_tag": "summitbridge"
  }
}```
Pri (PartnerOps): partner confirms they can surface company_size & primary_use_case if users sign via our form. they cannot push a CSV.
Rina (Content): landing will include hidden utm fields + micro-survey: "Primary use case" (select). will add consent checkbox text; sending draft to Lena by Apr 22.
Lena (Legal): flag: need written logo permission + quote approval before publish. ask Pri to get signed logo use form and quote signoff by Apr 24. will pre-review consent copy.
Jon (PMM): benchmark ask: short internal run for embeddings cost & 99th percentile latency. Rina can we include one chart + 2-sentence takeaway? Jon to provide data slice by Apr 25.
Rina (Content): yes. Jon send CSV or numbers by Apr 25; Ill slot the chart in the blog.
Omar (Sales Ops): SDR routing: if primary_use_case=="embeddings" and company_size>=1000 -> mark lead priority P0. hot leads (intent==high) -> post to #inbound-sales with: "Hot Lead (SummitBridge): <name> - <company> - <title> - <use_case> - <sfdc link>"
Maya (Growth): next steps checklist: Pri send partner checklist Apr 20; Lena get logo/quote review by Apr 24; Rina landing + blog draft Apr 22; Jon bench data Apr 25; assets final May 4; Omar to test webhook + Slack integration by May 20. OpsBot: Reminder created for webinar 2026-06-08 16:00 UTC. :robot_face:
Maya (Growth): call out blockers here. if partner delays assets, we push webinar back 1 week. :eyes:
